caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest rendered in light brown tones with a visible wood grain pattern, situated at the center of the composition. The chest features a flat top, dovetail joinery on the sides, a single wide drawer at the bottom, and two oval-shaped handles on the drawer, each handle adorned with a decorative pattern. Surrounding the central image are four smaller detailed sketches: the upper left shows two keyholes with diamond-shaped escutcheons, the upper right displays an enlarged oval handle with a floral and leaf motif, the lower left presents a straight-on side view of the chest, and the lower right highlights a close-up of the lower corner and leg, emphasizing the dovetail detail and the curve of the leg. The entire drawing is executed on a beige background with fine black framing lines that demarcate the main illustration from the details in the corners. There are handwritten notes designating scales for each detailed view.
title: Blanket Chest
